hook: Ever wonder how cloud computing lets you edit files anywhere without taking up phone storage?
script: GUEST: [expr:0.4] Petter, where is 'the cloud' actually located when I save my photos online?
HOST: [expr:0.7] The cloud isn't floating in the sky, it's just someone else's giant warehouse of supercomputers! When you tap save
HOST: [expr:0.7] your phone sends your files over the internet to massive, hyper-secure data centers packed with thousands of connected servers operating non-stop.
GUEST: [expr:0.5] So my phone just acts like a remote control for a distant computer?
HOST: [expr:0.8] Spot on! Your local device does almost no heavy lifting. The distant server handles all the storing,
HOST: [expr:0.8] processing, and backup, then streams the finished results straight back to your screen!
